title: 要求程式碼以原生語言撰寫並以高效方式實作
summary: Human-governor directive 2026-09-29: every new or modified code unit is authored in its registered native owner language and implemented efficiently. B157 carries the AUTHORING and EFFICIENT-WRITING clauses (compiled paths, bounded concurrency, batching, zero-copy, capacity reservation, one-pass processing, measured p50/p95/p99+CPU+RAM+VRAM+queue-depth evidence); B166 records the authoring rule against interpreted/scripting/retired fallbacks; metadata registers the authored-code and efficient-authoring policies; the architecture artifacts carry the same generation. Codex-only change: no implementation is migrated by this request.
origin: human-governor directive: 要求程式碼盡量使用原生語言編寫，並使用高效方式編寫

problem.summary: The performance article fixed the objective and PERF contract but did not state an authoring rule; the language article did not forbid interpreted or scripting authoring explicitly, and no registry key recorded the authored-code policy.
